Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
main.character.GameCharacter
main.character.Enemy
public class Enemy extends GameCharacter
Represents an enemy character in the game. Enemies have AI behavior to determine their actions in combat.

  • Constructor Details

    • Enemy

      public Enemy(String name, double maxHealth, int strength, int dexterity, int intelligence, int experienceReward)
      Creates a new enemy with specified stats.
      Parameters:
      name - The enemy's name
      maxHealth - The maximum health of the enemy
      strength - The enemy's strength stat (affects physical damage)
      dexterity - The enemy's dexterity stat (affects turn order)
      intelligence - The enemy's intelligence stat (affects magic damage)

    • Enemy

      public Enemy(String name, double maxHealth, int strength, int dexterity, int intelligence, int experienceReward, Weapon weapon, Armour armour, Shield shield)
      Creates a new enemy with specified stats and equipment.
      Parameters:
      name - The enemy's name
      maxHealth - The maximum health of the enemy
      strength - The enemy's strength stat (affects physical damage)
      dexterity - The enemy's dexterity stat (affects turn order)
      intelligence - The enemy's intelligence stat (affects magic damage)
      experienceReward - Experience rewarded upon death.
      weapon - The weapon to equip
      armour - The armour to equip
      shield - The shield to equip

      public void useHealingItem()

    • think

      public void think(GameCharacter attacker)
      Makes the enemy think about their next action. Determines the best action based on the current battle state.
      Parameters:

    • calculateNextAction

      public ActionType calculateNextAction(GameCharacter attacker)
      Calculates the next action for the enemy based on battle conditions. Uses AI logic that considers both the enemy's and attacker's health status.
      Parameters:
      attacker - The character the enemy is fighting against
      Returns:
      The calculated action type (ATTACK, DEFEND, or HEAL)
